title: Novel aromatic amide Pan-PPAR agonists for dual amelioration of hepatic steatosis and islet dysfunction by promoting cholesterol efflux in the KKAy diabetic mice.
authors: Sheng, Ren; Zhang, Yuyan; Wang, Jingrui; Yang, Guijun; Jiang, Weilian; Ju, Chuanjia; Li, Shunwang; Wang, Chenyin; Zhang, Jing; Lei, Lijuan; Wei, Xinwei; Liu, Tao; Liu, Chao; Xu, Yanni; Si, Shuyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型PPAR激动剂改善糖尿病小鼠肝脂肪变性和胰岛功能障碍，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cholesterol metabolism disorders are a major contributor to type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Cholesterol accumulation in the liver exacerbates insulin resistance, while cholesterol overload in the pancreatic islets impairs insulin secretion. Peroxisome proliferator activated receptors (PPARs) are considered potential therapeutic targets for cholesterol regulation. Herein, we report a series of novel aromatic amide derivatives as pan-PPAR agonists. Among them, compound 15a exhibited potent and well balanced pan-PPAR agonistic activity and significantly upregulated the expression of ATP binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1), a PPAR target gene involved in cholesterol efflux. In a high fat and high sucrose diet induced KKAy diabetic mouse model, 15a markedly reduced plasma cholesterol levels, hepatic cholesterol accumulation, and islet cholesterol deposition. It also demonstrated favorable regulation of glucolipid metabolism, leading to pronounced alleviation of hepatic steatosis and islet dysfunction, while avoiding the weight gain and adiposity side effects associated with PPARgamma agonists. SPR experiments demonstrated that 15a interacts with the ligand binding domains (LBDs) of all three PPAR subtypes. Molecular docking and single point mutation assays of key residues confirmed that 15a likely exerts its pan PPAR agonist activity by stabilizing helix 3 of the three PPAR subtypes. Furthermore, 15a exhibits improved pharmacokinetic properties and a favorable safety profile compared to the lead compound. In summary, this study demonstrates that compound 15a significantly ameliorates hepatic steatosis and islet dysfunction associated with T2DM by regulating cholesterol metabolism disorders along the liver-islet axis, highlighting its strong potential for treating hepatic lipid accumulation and T2DM related islet dysfunction.
abstract_zh: 胆固醇代谢紊乱是2型糖尿病（T2DM）的主要诱因之一。肝脏中胆固醇积累加剧胰岛素抵抗，而胰岛中胆固醇过载则损害胰岛素分泌。过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs）被认为是胆固醇调控的潜在治疗靶点。在此，我们报道一系列新型芳香酰胺衍生物作为泛PPAR激动剂。其中，化合物15a表现出强效且均衡的泛PPAR激动活性，并显著上调ATP结合盒转运蛋白A1（ABCA1）的表达，该基因是参与胆固醇外流的PPAR靶基因。在高脂高蔗糖饮食诱导的KKAy糖尿病小鼠模型中，15a显著降低血浆胆固醇水平、肝脏胆固醇积累及胰岛胆固醇沉积。它还表现出对糖脂代谢的有利调控，从而显著缓解肝脂肪变性和胰岛功能障碍，同时避免与PPARγ激动剂相关的体重增加和肥胖副作用。SPR实验表明，15a与所有三种PPAR亚型的配体结合域（LBDs）相互作用。分子对接及关键残基的单点突变实验证实，15a可能通过稳定三种PPAR亚型的螺旋3来发挥其泛PPAR激动活性。此外，与先导化合物相比，15a表现出改善的药代动力学特性和良好的安全性。总之，本研究证明化合物15a通过沿肝-胰岛轴调控胆固醇代谢紊乱，显著改善与T2DM相关的肝脂肪变性和胰岛功能障碍，凸显其在治疗肝脏脂质积累及T2DM相关胰岛功能障碍方面的强大潜力。
